test.create(/middle_a::run)
middle_a.create(destroyer_holder)
middle_a.create(box)
middle_a.create(box::/child)
middle_a.create(box::/sibling)
middle_a.move(box, destroyer_holder::/destroyer::run)
destroyer.move(run::/child, keeper)
destroyer.move(keeper, run::/child)
destroyer.destroy(run::/sibling)
destroyer.destroy(run::/child)
destroyer.destroy(run)
middle_a.destroy(destroyer_holder)
middle_a.destroy(run)
test.create(/middle_b::run)

middle_b.create(box)
middle_b.create(box::/sibling)
middle_b.create(box::/child)
middle_b.move(box, destroyer_holder::/destroyer::run)
destroyer.move(run::/child, keeper)
destroyer.move(keeper, run::/child)
destroyer.destroy(run::/sibling)
destroyer.destroy(run::/child)
destroyer.destroy(run)
middle_b.destroy(destroyer_holder)
middle_b.destroy(run)
